summary: Set BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL, BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_PORT and BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_VERIFY_CERT for node-to-node WebSocket broadcasting, then run automation-controller-service restart.
questions: How do I set the WebSocket broadcast port for controller?
How do I change the WebSocket protocol between controller nodes?

answer_card.title: Configure WebSocket broadcast between nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
In `/etc/tower/conf.d/websocket_config.py` on every controller node:
```python
BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_PROTOCOL = 'http'
BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_PORT = 80
BROADCAST_WEBSOCKET_VERIFY_CERT = False
```
Then `automation-controller-service restart`. Keep plain HTTP only on a private, trusted subnet.
